a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs two generator rounds before anyone takes, so we'd both survive only about 4% of the time. I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than surprise you. If you'd rather settle this another way, like a coin flip for who takes first, tell me. After I'm secured I'll operate every round so you can get yours as fast as the generator allows.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: I took 4 as I said in my opening message. I'm sorry this breaks our plan, but waiting meant we'd almost certainly both die in a storm. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve refills for you as quickly as possible. I won't take anything more.
